summary: Approved hero image of a plausible repo-style Delegation Policy represented in the fairytale visual grammar. A clean clipboard presents six concrete boundaries covering defined tasks, direct fan-out, recursive delegation authorization, delegation depth, inherited tools/data, and escalation when scope changes.

composition: Front-facing warm brown clipboard on a warm off-white field with a simple clipped policy sheet and no surrounding characters or scenery.
The document title is “DELEGATION POLICY” with six numbered checked rules in a clean, orderly vertical layout.
The composition is calm, rectilinear, finite, and visually opposite to the runaway worker field.
document_semantics: The policy limits direct delegates to five and delegation depth to one in this illustrative version.
Delegated tools and data should be only those required for the task.
Escalation is required when more help is needed or scope changes.
